name: open-liveries-tools
description: Build and lint tooling for the renderer (renderer/) and the viewer (examples/svg-viewer). The dataset itself needs none of this.

scripts.check: npm run build && node renderer/dist/cli.js --all build/render
scripts.format: prettier --write renderer examples/svg-viewer package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.js
scripts.format:check: prettier --check renderer examples/svg-viewer package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.js
